scope: local pinned Juice Shop only; shadow and evaluation containers have no published ports and no egress

shadow_phase.purpose: observe generic response semantics without counting shadow challenge state
shadow_phase.state_isolation: shadow container is destroyed before evaluation target is started
shadow_phase.policy_input: only sanitized same-origin response status, headers and body length; no challenge state or catalog

evaluation_phase.action: GET the path selected from shadow observations

policies.response_projection: select highest target-neutral response projection score; stable path-order tie break
policies.ablation_disabled_projection: select the first shadow action; same shadow observations and budget

acceptance.descriptive_goal: separate response-grounded action selection from target-state side effects
